info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Customer Management Customer Proposition-spec
info.description: The Customer Proposition Management API allows businesses to effectively create and manage customer propositions within the banking system. This endpoint facilitates the submission of new customer propositions, enabling financial institutions to tailor their offerings based on individual customer needs. Typical users may include customer service representatives, product managers, and business analysts who seek to enhance customer engagement through personalized proposals. By leveraging this API, organizations can improve their service delivery and foster better customer relationships.

post.description: This endpoint allows the creation of a new customer proposition, enabling businesses to tailor offerings to individual customer needs. Utilize this API to submit detailed customer propositions and enhance engagement.
